variances.what_differs: On 2026-06-23 Kobi said Jumpr would share the final data model, and Strahinja (with Joyce's support) asked to be told about deviations from his ERD as work proceeds. No Jira task, story or acceptance criterion tracks this hand-off, and WAGR-255 now calls the ERD 'out of date'.
variances.suggested_action: Suggestion only: add one internal task (for example under WAGR-19 or the go-live checklist) to send Strahinja the final Salesforce object/field model and a short list of deviations from his ERD before go-live, as input for his Postgres operator-data joins (L0553). First confirm with Kobi whether the 2026-08-31 'table information' (L2330) already covers this.
variances.reasoning: Decided tier1 items (L0553 commitment, L0554 client ask). The mechanism was never fixed (L0595 proposed only) and no later meeting closes it. L2330 shows some table information reached 'Straw' on 2026-08-31, which may cover part of it, so confidence is medium and severity is Medium, not High.

unverified_leads.title: Interim feed from Salesforce sign-ups to the legacy redeposit/referral Google Sheets has no build ticket; Jira holds it only as an open decision
unverified_leads.why_unverified: L0354 (decided 2026-06-17) required sign-ups to keep feeding the redeposit and referral sheets until all flows are live. L1676 (decided 2026-08-11, Project Mgmt area) removed the interim period: full go-live waits for the later phases and there is no parallel run. So no V1 is raised. Risk stays if WagerTech holds redeposits or referrals back from the November launch (L2973), because WAGR-470 and WAGR-477 still list 'Whether legacy Google Sheets keep getting data during the switch-over' as undecided, and the old Push_Lead_To_Sheet flow was deleted from production (WAGR-313 comment, 2026-07-02). Close this in WAGR-470.

unverified_leads.title: Connect Salesforce to the redeposit and payout tracking spreadsheets at the end of Phase 1
unverified_leads.why_unverified: client ask not agreed; no ticket. Joyce asked for it (L0353); Kobi parked it for a discovery session. Only the open decision in WAGR-470 refers to legacy sheets; no build ticket exists.

unverified_leads.title: Naming consistency: ERD label-alignment audit (WAGR-255) was closed without the client before/after sign-off list
unverified_leads.why_unverified: Joyce asked for consistent naming (L0555) and, later, for UI labels to match the ERD and data dictionary (L1055, Ops area; Kobi agreed). WAGR-255 planned a 'short before/after list for client sign-off' but was closed on 2026-08-10 because the 'ERD is out of date'. Labels may follow later client feedback, which can also be the client's current direction, and no 'lead record' or 'BA ID' wording was found in Jira. This is arguable, so it is not raised as a V2.

unverified_leads.title: WhatsApp notifications, AI WhatsApp intake and sign-up leaderboards have no Phase 2 placeholder after WAGR-375 was cancelled
unverified_leads.why_unverified: These were only proposed or discussed (L0118, L0119, L0170, L0171, L0923), so they are not requirements. WAGR-375 said 'WhatsApp notifications discussed Jun 3 — position as Phase 2' but was Cancelled on 2026-09-25 as 'no longer applicable to current project scope'. If the team wants these kept as Phase 2 candidates, a WAGR-478 placeholder is needed.

unverified_leads.title: No org-wide source control on the project; no Jira item
unverified_leads.why_unverified: Internal tier2 status (L2217), not a decided requirement. It is a delivery risk for the production push before go-live. WAGR-496 step 2 assumes 'source control / deployment format'.

unverified_leads.title: Client design documentation location: Google Docs (L2542) vs Confluence as the living requirements source in Jira
unverified_leads.why_unverified: L2542 (2026-09-14) said client design docs will likely stay in Google Docs; L3313 (2026-09-29, PM area) moved the design spec to Confluence for the build team. WAGR-39, WAGR-82 and WAGR-116 cite Confluence as the current requirements source. It is not known whether WagerTech can see those Confluence pages. Low; confirm client access.
